title: 3.5 Anniversary Discord Event: Sibling's Snapshot Spree Operation!
lines: The Story:

Nian, Our Great Director from Rhodes Island, has come up with a great idea (again)! She went to Amiya and volunteered to create a stunning booklet for the HR department, promising her magnificent work would be of great help to Rhodes Island's recruitment.

Before she could get to the real work, however, the Grand Tutor dragged her back to Yumen for the unfinished work there… So, our Great director is now calling for photo submissions from all Doctors! Anything that has elements from Rhodes Island is welcome!
Those who successfully win our director's favor at the end will be presented with mysterious awards from Nian! Doctors, grab your smartphones and snap a shot!
Time Duration:
Start: July 22nd, 9:00 P.M. (UTC-7)
End of submission: Aug 6th, 9:00 P.M. (UTC-7)
How to Participate:
Please join our official Discord Channel at https://discord.gg/arknights first if you haven't yet.

(Since the "Sibling's Snapshot Spree" event will be held on our Discord channel, Doctors will have to be its members first to participate in the event. We also recommend verifying your identity for your Discord account in advance, as it is required by Discord before you can send messages on the channel).
Entries must be submitted by using the “ /submit ” command in Shaw DMs (Doctors could find Shaw in the Discord Member List on the right as [BOT-1] Shaw). Please follow Shaw's instructions below:
1. Upload the image (less than 10MB) as a Discord attachment , NOT as a link
2. Submit your submission title
Submissions shall include Arknights-themed elements or real-life products within an image. Valid submissions include but are not limited to:
- Take a photo of an item in real life with Arknights elements (such as game merch).
- Print out Arknights elements and take a photo of them with the surroundings in your real life.
- Retouch a real photo with Arknights elements (please use )
- Doodle on a real photo using Arknights elements.

Participants will receive a congratulatory message from Shaw via Discord DM once their submission gets a pass. All qualified submissions will be displayed on #snapshot-showcase under the Sibling's Snapshot Spree category. If your submission does not meet the requirements above or violates the rules, it will be removed from the showcase channel. Please enable the DM on Discord to ensure that you will not miss the notification.
Channel list and features:
#snapshot-showcase : All qualified submissions will be displayed here.
#snapshot-discussion : A place to discuss topics related to the contest.
Rewards
Nian's Noble Nomination *10
Nendoroid - or a prize worth USD 60
Lava's Lucky List *20
$20 Gift Card
Notes

Winners will be announced on our social media pages and our Discord channel within 5 working days after the event concludes. The exact distribution time and method will be informed by official customer service staff via Discord DM. Please enable the DM to ensure that you will not miss the notification.
Please take care of your private information. Arknights EN is not responsible for any loss caused by mishandled private info.
ArknightsEN reserves the right to replace the mentioned gift card with prizes of the same value for winners of countries or regions where Apple or Google gift cards are unavailable.
Please note that each participant is limited to one award per event, and only the prize of the highest worth will be awarded if a participant wins multiple prizes
Rules

The total number of your submissions is not limited. But all submissions should cover the elements from both the [real world] and [Arknights] . Submissions lacking elements from either part will not be regarded as approved entries”
Submissions with content related to politics, violence, pornography, grotesque, or violating the rules will be invalidated. Commercial contents are also prohibited.
Participants must follow the established rules in Arknights official Discord channel during the event. Violating the rules will result in warnings or penalties.
Please report the works violating the rules to arknights.event@yo-star.com or official customer service.
ArknightsEN reserves the final explanation of the event.
